from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class InvestingCashFlowRecord(BaseModel):
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company reported in the document")
    metric_label: str | None = Field(description="The label of the cash flow line item as it appears in the report")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The numerical value of the cash flow; negative indicates 'used in'")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="The scale of the currency, e.g., 'thousands', 'millions', 'dollars'")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period covered by the financial statement")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    investing_cash_flow_records: list[InvestingCashFlowRecord]
